acceptance.parity_scope: Full same-grid chunks require identical SHA-256; trimmed seeks use allclose(rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5) and record exact equality/max difference.
acceptance.active_cancel_scope: Wait 150 ms after the supervisor started event, then revalidate generation/request. No GPU submission timestamp is observed.
acceptance.scope: synthetic saturated delivery, animated UI and independent silent audio; no stem playback/full deck or musical-quality claim

continuous_UI_scope.scope: Completed required UI frame-notification coverage; does not prove physical presentation latency or real stem playback.

ui_coverage.qualification: Zero full-minute bins disprove continuous frame-notification load. Nonzero minute counts alone cannot prove exact concurrent rendering at any particular hop or physical presentation.

timing.percentile_method: nearest rank; consecutive windows are not independent tail samples

scheduling.note: Deltas omitted when schedstats disabled/missing, process/task identities differ, or reads failed.

conclusion: Recurrent severe GPU-frequency reductions associated with PL1 remain the dominant stall signature under sustained observed UI frame activity. The GT is mostly awake and device runtime suspension does not explain these intervals. Exact firmware/platform-power versus driver-scheduling causation remains unresolved.
limits: Completed sixty-minute frame/audio coverage does not establish a hard maximum for future delivery or validate stem playback/full-deck audio.
Counter and clock evidence uses strictly interior sequential host snapshots, excluding unsampled edges and exact GPU batch timing.
PL1 flags are not watts and occur on good requests too. Correlation does not identify firmware/platform-power versus driver-scheduling causation. RAPL energy remains permission restricted.
Zero native major faults alone cannot exclude kernel GEM backing-store activity; system PSI/reclaim/swap evidence is reported separately.
Frame-notification gaps measure GUI-thread observations, not physical presentation latency.
No matching kernel graphics journal message is only bounded negative evidence; error-state/tracefs data remain unavailable.
Native runtime/model/window/math remain pinned. No runtime, power or kernel change is made by this investigation.
